description: ACM's acmart in its two-column conference format. As for acmart-manuscript, and as Flouest's acm template loads acmart: without General's font and AMS lines (acmart sets its own fonts and maths under XeTeX, and General's lmodern after its unicode-math emptied every maths glyph: 3,018 missing in 193 of 512 documents in batch 3b), and with an empty \title, since its page heads print \shorttitle, which only amsart's \title defines (a document with no title stopped on every odd page from the third: 200 of 512 documents, document-wide in 96). The page turns two-column only at \maketitle (acmart.dtx l.6898-6910), so a document with no title way is set in one 506pt column. Since b23 (ERRORS ACM-REFLINE) the setting turns off acmart's ACM Reference Format block (\settopmatter{printacmref=false}, acmart.cls l.1787-1792), which \maketitle prints after the title block (l.2329-2331) with \@title inline after the authors and the year (\@mkbibcitation, l.2891-2925): General's title is a box as wide as the line (title.ts), so after '. 2023. ' it ran 21.6pt past the measure in every document holding it (GitHub run r2-461ed0e: 0 of 13 General title branches passed in each acmart pair, e.g. d7bf5d19e2529793c571c, 'Overfull \hbox (21.60265pt too wide) ... . 2023. []'), and a title holding a footnote met the block's own \footnote, which stops at 'Please do not use footnotes inside a \title{} or \author{} command!' (l.2897-2899; 3 documents in each pair). acmart only warns at the end that the format is mandatory for papers over one page (l.1793-1800). A test-setting choice: Flouest's acm template writes \setcopyright{none} for a manuscript and keeps the block (O-AC8's \setcopyright{none}, left out in b22, does not touch it). With the block gone a title footnote no longer stops TeX, but acmart's title block still prints it nowhere (GitHub probe 41775212344, ERRORS-acm-fntitle-new: the note's sentinels never ship).
